description: Source code for a dashboard widget (dashlet) class 'PipelineBySalesStageDashlet' in SuiteCRM, which generates a chart visualizing sales pipeline data by sales stage, including data retrieval, chart data preparation, and rendering logic.

classes.name: PipelineBySalesStageDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class extending DashletGenericChart to display sales pipeline data by sales stage with chart rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with default date range and title, setting options if not provided.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Prepares and returns display options for sales stages filtering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the chart HTML/JavaScript with data fetched from the database, including chart configuration.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Executes the SQL query to retrieve sales stage data, ordered according to selected stages.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to fetch opportunities data grouped by sales stage within date range.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw data into chart-ready format with labels, data points, and totals.

methods.name: resizeLabel
methods.description: Truncates labels exceeding maximum length, appending ellipsis.
